label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3 a.7…: In every composite there is something that is not…
locator: I q.3 a.7 co., fifth proof: Sic igitur in omni composito est aliquid quod non est ipsum
interpretation: Read as: every composite has a component distinct from itself. The fifth proof's further step (God is form or esse itself, and in a form nothing is alien) is not formalized.
